Rae (release): Flagging an odd compatibility signal from EU-prod: a subset of routes see degraded accuracy after model=v5 and runtime=4.1 landed together. Thinking a split mitigation: model-pin to v4-checkpoint for the affected routes, and runtime soft-pin to 4.0.9 on the same region until we triage.
Ibrahim (runtime): Saw the telemetry. Not a crash, but KV cache miss pattern differs when model weights use new serialization. If model v5 relies on serialization produced by runtime 4.1, mixing becomes fragile.
Nia (sdk): Important: SDK routing must avoid mixing model_version!=runtime_pair. I can push a per-route rule that pins both model_version and runtime simultaneously, but that'll require a two-step deploy: runtime pin first, then model pin to avoid transient mismatch.
Kai (sre): Note on capacity: EU fallback pool runs near 75% on peak. Pinning runtime may shuffle traffic to older nodes; we need an autoscaler buffer check.
Zoe (qa): I can run a short canary: 40 requests with long-history prompts, comparing results before/after pin. Will post diffs.
Rae (release): Proposed plan: 1) deploybot apply regional soft-pin runtime=4.0.9 for model_family=orbit-* in eu-central for 3h; 2) after runtime pin confirmed, deploybot apply model-pin model=orbit-x version=v4-checkpoint in eu-central for same window; 3) SDK pushes routing label and ensures no mixed pairings; 4) QA runs canary; 5) SRE monitors capacity and latency. Any objections? :eyes:
Ibrahim (runtime): Agree. I'll instrument the KV serializer handshake to log mismatches and prepare a potential 4.1.1 compatibility patch.
Nia (sdk): Will prepare routing rules and a guard that refuses to route model=v5 to runtime!=4.1 once we lift pins. I'll attach an audit id.
Kai (sre): Doing a quick capacity sweep. If we go ahead, I'll temporarily raise autoscaler aggressiveness and set alert thresholds.
Rae (release): deploybot, schedule runtime soft-pin in 4m with 5m cooldown, include rollback link: https://go/internal/runbooks/pins/rollback-split-pin and tag the change with incident-6932100000.
deploybot: Received request:
  action: soft-pin
  runtime: 4.0.9
  model_filter: family=orbit-*
  scope: region=eu-central
  window: 3h
  cooldown: 5m
  initiated_by: Rae (release)
deploybot: Running preflight checks...
ci-bot: Preflight: routing graph OK; eu-central capacity headroom 18%; no blocking hotfixes; dependent model-pins clear.
deploybot: Executing runtime soft-pin in 30s...
Nia (sdk): Runtime pin applied. Console label: "eu-central-splitpin-runtime-6932100000". Audit ID: sdk-audit-6932.
Zoe (qa): Running canary now (40 reqs). Posting quick summary in 15m.
Ibrahim (runtime): Runtime metrics: KV handshake mismatch logs increased before pin, now stable. No latency regres vs baseline.
Zoe (qa): Canary results: model-v5 on pinned runtime shows improvement in accuracy vs the mixed setup; model v4-checkpoint baseline aligns cleanly. No regressions observed.
Rae (release): OK proceeding with model-pin now. deploybot, apply model-pin with same scope/window.
deploybot: Received request:
  action: model-pin
  model: orbit-x
  version: v4-checkpoint
  scope: region=eu-central
  window: 3h
  cooldown: 0m
  initiated_by: Rae (release)
ci-bot: Preflight: model storage availability OK; no conflicting pins; audit path healthy.
deploybot: Applying model-pin...
Nia (sdk): Model pin applied. Console label: "eu-central-splitpin-model-6932100000". Audit ID: sdk-audit-6932-m.
Ibrahim (runtime): Post-pins telemetry looks stable. KV metrics aligned and miss rate down.
Kai (sre): Watching autoscaler; small traffic shift observed, autoscaler scaled up one node, no throttles.
Zoe (qa): Post-pin smoke: 20m run, accuracy good, no timeouts. I'll attach diffs to the ticket.
Rae (release): Thanks team. Keeping triage open until runtime team finalizes patch. If we need to extend window we'll notify CS and schedule comms. Closing thread when pins are lifted or if escalation needed. :white_check_mark:
